description: Give AI agents eyes on the web via Grabbit hosted screenshot MCP. Use when the user needs a webpage screenshot, URL-to-image capture, screenshot MCP, Claude/Cursor/Codex browser snapshot, OpenClaw or Hermes page grab, or an alternative to Urlbox, ScreenshotOne, or ApiFlash for agent workflows.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent execute the browser workflow deterministically with explicit checkpoints?
Did the agent verify final browser state with concrete evidence?
